chunks: From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamza, raising it, he said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Surah Al-An'am was revealed in its totality, escorted by seventy thousand angels until it was revealed to Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). Therefore, magnify it and revere it, for the Name of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is in it in seventy places, and had the people known what is in its recitation, they would not have neglected it.'

key_terms.جُمْلَةً: In its totality / all at once
key_terms.سُورَةَ الْأَنْعَامِ: Surah Al-An'am (The Cattle), the sixth chapter of the Quran

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of Surah Al-An'am regarding the angels and the Name of Allah?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the immense virtue of Surah Al-An'am, stating it was revealed in its entirety with a grand escort of seventy thousand angels. He urges believers to magnify and revere the Surah because the Name of Allah appears in it seventy times, and its deep merits would prevent people from neglecting it if they truly knew. This narration underscores the unique status of this Meccan Surah within Shia tradition, linking its revelation magnitude to the frequency of the Divine Name, a metric often associated with the completeness of divine attributes discussed in the Surah.

en.hubeali: From him, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Abu Hamza, raising it, said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Surah Al-Anam (Chapter 6) was Revealed in its totality. Seventy thousand Angels escorted it until it was Revealed unto Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>. Therefore, you should magnify it and revere it, for the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic is in it in seventy places, and had the people known what is in its recitation, they would not be neglecting it’.
en.sarwar: 12. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn abu Hamza in a marfu’ manner from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “Chapter six ( al-An ’am) was revealed all in one piece escorted by seventy thousand angels until it came down upon Muhammad, recipient of divine supreme covenant. You must maintain its greatness and respect it. The name of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, is mentioned therein at seventy places. Had people known what is in reading it, they would not have ignored it.”
